purpose: G3: extend the measured DFR band one order of magnitude below the headline point, on the SAME 92-key formal pool.
frozen_before: first decode of this phase (see file mtime)
hypothesis: RR(FRO-2 vs C0) at t=90 is larger than the t=92 value 4.15 and its 95% key-clustered CI excludes 1.

design.pool: KeyPool(20260901, P1prime, 'G0', {random,100}) keys 8..99, identical to exp_round_controls.phase1 G0 (the headline pool)
design.error_generator: make_error_generator(20260901,'G0',key_id,param{t=90},'G0'-spec,key,None), error ids 0..E-1, same error ids for every arm
design.decoder: bf_parallel, classic threshold, max_iter=20 (identical carrier to the headline result)
design.chunking: 4000 errors/key per chunk; state checkpointed after each chunk; arms added per chunk on identical instances, so pairing is exact

stopping_rule.note: sample-size stopping rule, NOT significance-based: the decision rule is fixed in advance and never looks at RR.
stopping_rule.after_cap: if the cap is reached below target, report the achieved CI as-is; do not extend the sample.

analysis.primary: cluster_bootstrap_paired(per_key C0, per_key FRO-2, errors_per_key, B=10000, seed=20260905)

falsification: CI includes 1, or RR <= 4.15, falsifies the 'strengthens toward lower DFR' hypothesis; either way the result is reported as measured.
prior_expectation: t=90 saw 1/30000 C0 failures on a different 30-key pool; target 120 failures at 92 keys implies ~40k errors/key if DFR ~3.3e-5.

amendments.written_before: the first real (non-smoke) chunk of phase T90
amendments.reason: A 20-errors/key smoke run produced 1 C0 failure in 1840 trials, hinting the main pool t=90 DFR may be ~5e-4 rather than the ~3.3e-5 seen on the phase2 t-sweep pool (different keys). The stopping rule below is unchanged.
amendments.contingency: If the completed T90 run yields C0 DFR > 1.5e-4, run one further point at t=88 on the SAME pool with the identical design and stopping rule, so the scaling family reaches at least one clearly-lower C0 DFR. No other adaptation will be made.
amendments.disclosure: smoke used error ids 0..19 on all 92 keys at t=90; it is part of the final T90 sample (chunk 1 reuses ids 0..3999 in full).

amendments.written_before: chunks 2..N of phase T90 (after chunk 1 only)
amendments.note: The main pool DFR at t=90 is 5.98e-5 (17x below t=92), not far from the tsweep-pool hint. The pre-registered stopping rule (target 120 C0 failures, cap 100k errors/key) is UNCHANGED; at this DFR it implies about 5-6 chunks total (~22 min each).
amendments.disclosure: Same-pool RR at t=90 (3.14, wide CI) is LOWER than the t=92 headline RR 4.15, whereas the cross-pool t-sweep suggested RR grows as DFR falls (7.00 at t=92 on the tsweep pool). The extra sampling will discriminate between a real trend and a pool artefact; both outcomes will be reported as measured.
